subject: Acme — change to technical deep dive + timing
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Howard <alex.howard@acme-industries.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Intro demo — proposed times

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for your interest in Redwood Inference. Per our call, I wanted to propose a short intro demo to show the hosted API, latency/cost examples, and a quick highlight of Dedicated/Private options.

Would any of these work for your team next week?
- Tue, Sep 16 — 10:00–10:30 AM PT
- Wed, Sep 17 — 1:00–1:30 PM PT

Agenda (30 min):
- 5m quick intros
- 10m product walkthrough (API, model catalog, perf stories)
- 10m Q&A / next steps
- 5m propose mutual action plan

If you want to bring engineers and go deeper, we can extend to 60–90 minutes — happy to rework the agenda. I attached a short demo deck for context.

Best,
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai
(415) 555-0173

Attachment: Demo-deck.pdf

From: Alex Howard <alex.howard@acme-industries.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@acme-industries.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Sep 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposed times

Hi Stephanie —

Thanks — this looks great. Quick note from our side: rather than an intro demo, we'd prefer a technical deep dive that includes our ML infra and platform engineers. Can we expand to a 90-minute session to cover integration patterns, auth/KMS, and a POC scoping segment?

We'd prefer Thu, Sep 17 at 1:00 PM PT if that slot is available. If not, Fri, Sep 18 afternoon works too.

Also please include any pre-reads you think are useful for our engineers.

Thanks,
Alex Howard
Director of Platform Engineering | Acme Industries
alex.howard@acme-industries.com

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Howard <alex.howard@acme-industries.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 11 Sep 2025 08:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro demo — proposed times

Alex —

Totally understood and happy to convert to a technical deep dive + POC scoping. Two quick logistics items on our side:

1) Lead availability — I’m scheduled to travel on Thu 9/17 and will be in transit during the 1pm PT slot. I can still coordinate and prep, but I won’t be the primary presenter. Monica (CS lead) or Rishi (Solutions Architect) can run the deep dive.

2) Timing — options:
  A) Keep Thu 9/17 1:00–2:30 PM PT and have Monica lead (she’s familiar with your stack).
  B) Move to Fri 9/18 11:00–12:30 PM PT so I can present and join the POC scoping myself.

Please pick A or B and share the list of attendees (names + roles). If you confirm A, Monica will send the invite and we’ll attach a technical agenda. If you prefer B we’ll update the calendar accordingly.

Draft 90-minute agenda attached and a short pre-read (architecture notes + API examples):
- 5m intros and goals
- 25m architecture & deployment modes (Hosted/Dedicated/Private)
- 25m integration deep dive (auth, KV cache, batching, quantization options)
- 20m POC scoping (data, SLAs, metrics, success criteria)
- 15m open Q&A / next steps

Let me know ASAP so we can lock in invite and get your engineers the pre-reads.

Thanks —
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai

Attachment: Acme-Deep-Dive-Agenda.pdf

From: Alex Howard <alex.howard@acme-industries.com>

Stephanie / Monica —

Thanks for the options. We’ll go with option A and keep Thu, Sep 17 1:00–2:30 PM PT with Monica leading. Attendees from Acme: Jordan Lee (Staff ML Engineer), Priya Suresh (SRE), and myself.

Jordan — looping you for any additional items you want covered.

Please send the calendar invite and the final agenda + pre-reads. If possible, include a short note about expected firewall/egress settings we need to prep for Private deployments.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — see you Thursday.

Best,
Alex Howard
Director of Platform Engineering | Acme Industries
